ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels accounting for approximately 90-95% of the visible surface area, with low-frequency high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels concentrated at the tips and along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-grey to black base. Light-grey mottling is present on the distal edges of both lobes. Isolated white focal spots are sparsely distributed across the central and lower regions of the fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible as an obtuse, shallow U-shaped depression; estimated interior angle at the vertex is approximately 140 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and irregular. Significant pixel-amplitude variations (jaggedness) are visible along the entire trailing edge, with particularly deep, non-uniform indentations on the upper edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the distal edges of both lobes, sweeping outward and upward to sharp, acute vertices at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast white clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, characterized by circular/ovoid pixel groupings.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Evidence of significant traumatic tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe, manifesting as a series of three distinct, irregular semi-circular indentations (notches).
